subject: A free, private resume-tailoring tool for your Free Career Tools page
body:
Hi UW Bothell Career Services team,

I came across your Free Career Tools page and noticed it already points students to Jobscan, Candid Career, and Teal. We built a free resume-tailoring tool that might be a useful addition there.

TailorScan compares a resume to a specific job posting and lists the missing keywords, ranked by whether the posting puts them under required or preferred qualifications. It also runs nine ATS formatting checks: quantified bullets, weak phrasing, standard headings, and table layouts that parsers scramble.

It is free and unlimited, needs no login, and runs entirely in the browser, so no student resume or personal data is ever uploaded or stored. That makes it something students and alumni can keep using for every application, without scan limits or an account.

You can try it with any posting here: https://nishu1996builds.github.io/tailorscan/?utm_source=careercenter&utm_campaign=uwbothell

If it looks like a fit, would you consider adding it to your list of resources? We'd also value your team's honest feedback on anything it gets wrong for your students' fields.

Thanks,
The TailorScan team
tailorscan.help@gmail.com

P.S. If this isn't relevant, just reply "no thanks" and we won't follow up.
